title: Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters
description: Given a string s, find the length of the longest substring that contains no repeating characters. A substring is a continuous part of the string.
constraints:
1 <= length of s <= 5 * 10^4
s contains only lowercase English letters and digits.
inputFormat: A single line containing the string s.
outputFormat: A single integer, the length of the longest substring without repeating characters.
hints: Checking every substring works, but it is too slow for long strings.
Keep a window that never contains a repeated character.
When a character repeats, move the left edge of the window just past its previous position.

examples.explanation: The longest such substring is abc, with length 3.
Every substring of length 2 or more repeats b.
The answer is wke. Note that pwke is not a substring.
